title: [auto-fix] Accept rvalue-reference qualifiers on function types
description:
ParseFunctionType currently accepts only the `R` lvalue-reference qualifier. The Itanium ABI permits `O` for an rvalue-reference qualifier too, and both failing mangled names contain it. Accept either qualifier so the existing parser can consume these types.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `Demangle.ReferenceQualifiedFunctionTypes`
